name: Bewitch
body:
School illusion; Level bard 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 10 min./level

DESCRIPTION

This spell makes you appear more likable, more attractive, and easier to talk to and deal with.

You gain a +4 circumstance bonus on Bluff and Diplomacy checks for the duration of the spell.
